subject: Business Models
title: Sharing Economy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Sharing Economy.

hook.text: Your car sits parked 95% of the time. Your spare room is empty most nights. The sharing economy monetizes idle assets.

buildup.text: Uber, Airbnb, and TaskRabbit let people earn from underused assets: cars, homes, skills, and time.

discovery.text: GPS, smartphones, and digital payments removed the friction that made asset-sharing impractical before 2010.

twist.text: Critics say the 'sharing economy' is really a 'gig economy.' Workers share the risk; platforms capture the profit.

climax.text: The sharing economy solved access but created new labor problems. The model is powerful but socially contested.

punchline.text: Your idle car, their profit. Sharing economy monetizes what you don't use.

quiz.question: What criticism does the sharing economy face?
options: Workers bear risk while platforms capture most profit
